title: mentha gentilis subsp. pratensis
intro: Mentha gentilis subsp. pratensis, commonly known as Welsh pennyroyal, is a subspecies of the mint plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is known for its essential oils, which have been used for centuries in traditional medicine, offering a range of health benefits including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in digestion and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Welsh pennyroyal include its ability to relax muscles, improve circulation, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Mentha gentilis subsp. pratensis include menthone, limonene, and pulegone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
